IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: RESULTS FOR AMERICA HELPS GOVERNMENTS FIND, FUND, AND IMPLEMENT SOLUTIONS THAT MEASURABLY IMPROVE ECONOMIC MOBILITY. RFA'S MISSION IS TO MAKE INVESTING IN WHAT WORKS THE "NEW NORMAL", SO THAT GOVERNMENT DECISION-MAKERS WILL REGULARLY AND EFFECTIVELY USE EVIDENCE AND DATA TO INCREASE THE IMPACT OF GOVERNMENT SPENDING TO IMPROVE THE LIVES OF YOUNG PEOPLE, THEIR FAMILIES AND COMMUNITIES.

IRS990.Desc: STANDARDS OF EXCELLENCE: RESULTS FOR AMERICA WORKS TO BUILD THE CAPACITY OF GOVERNMENT DECISION MAKERS AND NON-PROFIT LEADERS TO IMPLEMENT EVIDENCE-BASED PRACTICES, WITH THE LONG-TERM GOAL OF HELPING THEM MAKE MORE EFFECTIVE USE OF RESOURCES, TO SCALE EFFECTIVE SOLUTIONS, AND TO ACHIEVE BETTER OUTCOMES FOR THEIR RESIDENTS. OUR STANDARDS OF EXCELLENCE - WHAT WORKS CITIES CERTIFICATION, STATE STANDARD OF EXCELLENCE, AND FEDERAL STANDARD OF EXCELLENCE - HELP GOVERNMENTS BENCHMARK THEIR EXISTING DATA AND EVIDENCE CAPACITY AND PROVIDE A ROADMAP FOR HOW TO ACCELERATE THEIR PROGRESS AND DELIVER BETTER RESULTS.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: IMPLEMENTATION SUPPORT: RFA'S IMPLEMENTATION SUPPORT HELPS OUR GOVERNMENT PARTNERS MOVE FROM AWARENESS OF SOLUTIONS THAT WORK TO TAKING ACTION TO IMPLEMENT THOSE SOLUTIONS. THROUGH OUR SHIFTING DOLLARS TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE (SM), WE PROVIDE RESOURCES, TRAININGS, AND COACHING TO HELP GOVERNMENTS INVEST PUBLIC FUNDS IN HIGHER-IMPACT SOLUTIONS. OUR EVIDENCE-BASED SPENDING GUIDES OFFER A CLEAR ROADMAP TO INVEST IN WHAT WORKS. AND THROUGH OUR SOLUTIONS ACCELERATOR, WE SUPPORT LEADERS FROM EARLY-STAGE RESEARCH THROUGH FULL IMPLEMENTATION OF EVIDENCE-BASED SOLUTIONS.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: MOVEMENT BUILDING: RFA WORKS WITH DATA-DRIVEN, RESULTS-ORIENTED LEADERS AT EVERY LEVEL OF GOVERNMENT, ACROSS THE COUNTRY AND ACROSS THE POLITICAL SPECTRUM. OUR MOBILIZATION EFFORTS HELP BUILD MOMENTUM FOR CHANGE IN GOVERNMENT BY MOTIVATING AND CELEBRATING POLICYMAKERS WHO ARE INVESTING IN WHAT WORKS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION IS EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL INCOME TAX UNDER SECTION 501(C)(3) OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE. THE ORGANIZATION HAS ADOPTED THE PROVISIONS OF ACCOUNTING FOR UNCERTAINTY IN INCOME TAX POSITIONS AS REQUIRED BY INCOME TAXES (TOPIC 740) OF THE FASB ACCOUNTING STANDARDS CODIFICATION (ASC); HOWEVER, MANAGEMENT DOES NOT BELIEVE IT IS EXPOSED TO ANY SUCH POSITIONS AS DEFINED IN THIS GUIDANCE, NOR DO THEY EXPECT THIS TO CHANGE SIGNIFICANTLY OVER THE NEXT 12 MONTHS. THE ORGANIZATION FILES FORM 990, RETURN OF ORGANIZATION EXEMPT FROM INCOME TAX, ANNUALLY WITH THE UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF THE TREASURY. SUCH RETURNS ARE SUBJECT TO EXAMINATION BY TAXING AUTHORITIES, GENERALLY FOR A PERIOD OF THREE YEARS FROM THE DATE THE RETURNS ARE FILED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: 1. GRANT AGREEMENT SIGNED TO STIPULATE AMOUNT OF SUBAWARD, REPORTING REQUIREMENTS, CONTRACT PERSONS AND DETAILS ON THE TERMS OF THE AGREEMENT 2. AFTER AGREEMENT IS SIGNED, THE MONEY IS SENT BASED ON TERMS OF THE AGREEMENT AND CONFIRM RECEIPT OF FUNDS. 3. MIDWAY THROUGH THE GRANT AND AT THE END OF THE GRANT, BASED ON THE TERMS OF THE AGREEMENT, GRANTEE REPORTS ON PROGRAMMATIC ACTIVITIES AND SPENDING 4. RFA REVIEWS THE SUBMITTED REPORTS AND COMPARES IT TO THE GRANT AGREEMENT TO ENSURE ADHERENCE TO THE AGREEMENT 5. RFA FOLLOWS UP WITH GRANTEE TO CONFIRM WHETHER THEY ARE USING FUNDS IN THE FUTURE FOR THE APPROVED CHARITABLE 501(C)(3) PURPOSES, IF NOT RFA REQUIRES FUNDS BE RETURNED.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15: EACH FALL, AS PART OF RFA'S ANNUAL BUDGETING AND PERFORMANCE REVIEW PROCESS, THE HR TEAM REVIEWS COMPENSATION COMPARABLES. THE HR TEAM ANALYZES SALARIES FOR ALL LEVELS OF STAFFFROM CEO TO PROGRAM ASSISTANTUSING DATA FROM PNP STAFFING REPORTS AND SIMILAR SOURCES. THE FINDINGS ARE PRESENTED TO THE EXECUTIVE TEAM DURING THE ANNUAL BUDGET REVIEW AND APPROVAL PROCESS, AT WHICH TIME THE COMPENSATION RANGES FOR EACH LEVEL ARE APPROVED.
